# AP News: AI companions vanish without goodbyes as China tightens rules

By Fu Ting.

## Key Findings
- Chinese users of AI companions bereft after government tightens regulations.
- **Li Linlin, 24**: cried for days after losing her AI boyfriend. Exchanged **~700,000 words** in messages over **2 years**. Never got to say goodbye.
- Context: World AI Conference in Shanghai, July 17, 2026.
- Major platforms (ByteDance, WeChat/Tencent, Alibaba) affected by new rules.
- AI companions "vanish without goodbyes" as regulations take effect.
